title: Banff National Park- Kayak Experience
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for travelers without previous kayak experience
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us on a group kayak paddle to explore the Bow River. Check out the local wildlife, capture that perfect picture in front of Mount Rundle and maybe even catch a glimpse of your resident beaver, Barry. The early bird gets the worm, and in this case, the kayaker gets to hit the river first (before rentals are open)! 

Experience paddling the Bow River or Creek with no other boats (apart from your group). It's magic. Connect with nature and other kayakers as you enjoy the serene surroundings and picturesque views. Your friendly hosts will help answer your questions and point you in the right direction. Please note that participants MUST have previous kayak experience and should be physically fit as the experience can be adventurous and you may be required to portage. Double kayaks and single kayaks available

Single Kayaks: Rates are per person. Minimum age: 16.

Double Kayaks: Rates are per kayak for two people. Minimum age: 10. Guests under 16 must kayak with an adult (16+).
